name: MenuButton
summary: A button that opens a menu, marked by a trailing chevron and styled as selected while its menu is open. Use it as a Menu's trigger when the button does nothing but open the menu; use a split button when there is also a default action.

inputs.name: menuIcon
inputs.description: The trailing indicator that the button opens a menu; a chevron by default.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: As button; also sizes the menu icon.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: As button, but always before the label: MenuButton has no iconPosition.

inputs.name: children
inputs.description: As button: the label; without one the button is icon-only and the menu icon has no leading gap.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: As button; takes the appearance's Selected colours while its menu is open.

anatomy.name: Icon
anatomy.description: As button, always before the label.

anatomy.name: Menu icon
anatomy.description: A small square chevron after the label: 12px at small and medium, 16px at large.

variants.description: Expanded: Background1Selected fill, Stroke1Selected border, Foreground1Selected text.
Expanded: colorBrandBackgroundSelected fill; text and border as button.
Expanded: a strokeWidthThicker colorNeutralStroke1Selected border and Foreground1Selected text over no fill.
Expanded: colorSubtleBackgroundSelected fill and Foreground2Selected text.
Expanded: colorTransparentBackgroundSelected fill and Foreground2BrandSelected text.
As button; the menu icon is 12, 12 and 16px.

layout.text: Geometry, padding, minimum widths, icon sizes and text are as button, with the icon forced to the before position.
The menu icon is a 12px square glyph on lineHeightBase200 at small and medium and a 16px one on lineHeightBase400 at large, with spacingHorizontalXS before it unless the button is icon-only.
Expanded outline widens the border to strokeWidthThicker inside the same border box, so the outer size holds.

states.text: Closed: rest, hover, pressed, focus and disabled are as button.
While its menu is open (aria-expanded) the root takes the appearance's Selected tokens and the icons show their filled variants.
Hovering an expanded button shows button's hover colours, since the expanded styles declare no hover of their own; the transition is as button.
As button: the inset colorStrokeFocus2 ring.

behaviour.text: As a MenuTrigger's child it opens its menu on click, Enter, Space or ArrowDown, and reports aria-expanded while open.
The icon always sits before the label; any iconPosition is overridden.
Activation, focus visibility, disabledFocusable and the colour transition are as button.

keyboard: Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens the menu
Escape in the menu closes it and returns focus here
semantics: aria-expanded true while the menu is open
an icon-only menu button needs an aria-label

notes.text: The menu icon's 12px and 16px sizes are constants in the styles file.

The expanded icon colours are never applied: the class list passes iconExpandedStyles[appearance] && iconExpandedStyles.highContrast, which yields only the high-contrast class. The icon inherits the root's expanded text colour instead, so a subtle button's icon is Foreground2Selected, not the Foreground2BrandSelected the file intends.
The default menu icon is a chevron pointing down; the slot's content is set in the hook, which is not vendored.
The only forced-colours rule added is that an expanded button's icon turns Highlight on hover; everything else is as button.
